itens.titulo: Bitcoin ETFs Post Their Best Day in Nearly a Month as BlackRock Does All the Buying
itens.descricao: Bitcoin ETFs Post Their Best Day in Nearly a Month as BlackRock Does All the Buying Yahoo Finance
trechos: spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $526.7 million on Monday, their biggest single day since Sept.
22, according to Decrypt's ETF tracker.
The last bigger session brought $714.7 million, which makes this the best day for the funds in nearly a month.
The inflow interrupted two weeks of selling in which the funds shed about $910 million, including a $484.9 million exit on Oct.
7, which was their worst day since June.
Friday closed with another $82.4 million of net selling, which makes Monday a sharp turn.
BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) did the heavy lifting with $665.2 million, more than the entire net total, according to Farside Investors.
Fidelity's FBTC lost $83.6 million and Grayscale's GBTC lost $54.9 million, while the other funds recorded no flows at all.

itens.titulo: Abicom: Diesel da Petrobras se aproxima ao subsídio com alta do Brent
itens.descricao: Abicom: Diesel da Petrobras se aproxima ao subsídio com alta do Brent CNN Brasil
trechos: A disparada do preço do petróleo no mercado internacional está colocando em risco o novo aumento dado à subvenção do diesel para importadores no Brasil, que chegou a R$ 3,52 o litro no início de outubro.
Com o Brent a US$ 111 o barril no fechamento de da segunda-feira (19) o preço de paridade de importação subiu para R$ 3,50 o barril, apenas dois centavos a menos do que o subsídio.

Segundo a Abicom (Associação Brasileira dos Importadores de Combustíveis), a defasagem nas refinarias da Petrobras já é de R$ 3,50 o litro para o diesel, enquanto a diferença da gasolina está em 20%, ou R$ 0,43 litro a menos do que o preço externo.
Na Refinaria de Mataripe, na Bahia, controlada pelo fundo de investimentos árabe Mubadala, a defasagem do diesel era de 44% no fechamento da segunda, e de 11% no caso da gasolina.

Segundo o analista de inteligência de mercado da Stonex, Bruno Cordeiro, "estima-se que hoje cerca de 8 milhões de barris por dia estejam sendo escoados pelo canal, em comparação com quase 18 milhões de barris por dia observados em setembro", explicou.

"Não há novos canais oficiais de comunicação entre Teerã e Washington, e isso acaba alimentando a percepção de que o mercado deve trabalhar com uma oferta menor vinda de países do Oriente Médio ao longo das próximas semanas", afirmou.

itens.descricao: What Is Coca-Cola (KO) Rethinking In Its Coffee Business? Yahoo Finance
trechos: - The renewed process follows Coca-Cola's acquisition of Costa Coffee in 2018, which expanded its presence in the global coffee segment.

For anyone watching how beverage groups balance core products with side bets such as coffee chains, it can be useful to compare this with companies that pay steady income through dividends, starting with 8 dividend fortresses.

itens.titulo: Alphabet set for earnings beat as Cloud and AI chips take centre stage
itens.descricao: Alphabet set for earnings beat as Cloud and AI chips take centre stage Yahoo Finance
trechos: The firm forecasts third-quarter revenue of US$111.4 billion and GAAP earnings per share of US$3.07, ahead of the Street's US$111.0 billion and US$2.98 when Alphabet reports on October 28.
BofA sees growth of 93%, against consensus of 89%, driven by expanding capacity and incremental TPU sales.
Search growth is expected to land in line with the Street at 15%, though BofA's checks suggest some deceleration in the quarter.
BofA expects operating expenses of US$33.5 billion, below the Street's US$34.3 billion, helped by lower depreciation and amortization of US$8 billion versus US$8.9 billion.
On the earnings call, BofA will watch search volumes, a potential consumer agentic launch, Gemini 4 capabilities and any data on TPU sales and outlook, which it calls a key 2027 upside case.
BofA estimates 2026 capital expenditures of about US$200 billion, compared with the Street's US$202 billion, and about US$300 billion in 2027, with a bias to the upside.
For the fourth quarter, BofA forecasts revenue of US$123.9 billion and EPS of US$3.33, in line with the Street.

itens.titulo: Google says services recovering after cloud outage hits UK banks and websites
itens.descricao: Google says services recovering after cloud outage hits UK banks and websites BBC
trechos: The company, one of a few large cloud computing firms whose infrastructure and services underpin many online platforms, reported an "issue with multiple services" at its London data centre complex "europe-west2" early on Tuesday.

"We have resolved a disruption to Google Cloud services at a third-party facility in our europe-west2 cloud region due to a power event," a Google Cloud spokesperson said in a statement on Tuesday evening.

In updates to its service dashboard on Tuesday morning, Google Cloud had said a number of its cloud services were "experiencing elevated errors and intermittent network failures in europe-west2 region" - its UK cloud facility in London.
It later said that the issues had stemmed from a "power event" within one of its smaller data centre zones, europe-west2-b.
Rachael Ellen, 25, a Revolut customer from Glasgow, told BBC News she was left unable to access her money.
"Today I was unable to pay for my parking at a shopping centre because my Revolut account wasn't working properly," she told the BBC.
"It's frustrating not knowing where the payment is or when I'll receive it," Rachael added.
More than 1,500 reports of issues affecting Revolut services were flagged to platform outage monitor shortly after 08:00 BST on Tuesday.

itens.titulo: JPMorgan sees 10% annual bitcoin returns, topping stocks, bonds and gold over next decade
itens.descricao: JPMorgan sees 10% annual bitcoin returns, topping stocks, bonds and gold over next decade CoinDesk
trechos: JPMorgan sees 10% annual bitcoin returns, topping stocks, bonds and gold over next decade The report marks the first time JPMorgan has put a range on bitcoin returns in its research, though the bank remains cautious about BTC's role in portfolios.
- JPMorgan Asset Management projects bitcoin will return 10% annually over the next decade in its base case, outpacing its forecasts for U.S.
- The asset manager’s first range of long-term bitcoin forecasts spans from a 9.7% annual loss in its bear case to a 17% annual gain in its bull case.
The asset manager forecasted a base case of 10% annualized returns for bitcoin over the next 10 years in its 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions report on Tuesday.
The bank also set a bear case of -9.7% and a bull case of 17%.
The figure compared to projected 5.6%-6.6% growth in U.S.
large and small-cap equities respectively and 5.5% in gold.
Dimon famously described the world’s largest crypto as a “fraud” in 2017, a skeptical position he has reiterated with somewhat softer verbiage in recent years.
